title: Environmental Services Project Manager
descriptionText: Requisition ID: 43820 NextEra Energy Resources is one of the largest wholesale generators of electric power and renewable energy from the wind and sun in North America. Position Specific Description **The position is based in the western US, preferably in the Pacific Northwest; however other locations in the western US will be considered.** This position is in the Environmental Licensing & Permitting Section of the Corporate Environmental Services Department supporting new development opportunities for NextEra Energy Resources and other NextEra Energy affiliates. Applicant must have relevant Project Management experience with ability to lead, with limited direction, new corporate development opportunities and acquisitions in power generation, storage and transmission projects, including renewable energy facilities, transmission lines, and battery storage. Primary responsibilities include obtaining all required federal, state and local environmental licenses, permits and approvals for development projects in US states west of the Rocky Mountains with a focus on WA, OR, MT and WY, as well as providing other project support such as siting and community outreach. The primary focus will be on licensing and permitting new solar, wind and transmission facilities. Applicant must have ability to support multiple projects with multifaceted environmental and regulatory issues, ability to assist in comprehensive environmental due diligence reviews for potential acquisitions, and be willing to travel up to 50% of the time when needed. The successful candidate must maintain current knowledge of pertinent national and state level environmental policies and regulations, have the ability to effectively interface with internal and external customers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders, and be able to assist in resolving complex environmental matters. He or she must help ensure compliance with federal, state and local environmental regulations, as well as company policies. Routine out of state travel will be required. Job Overview Employees in this job provide specialized environmental expertise and environmental technical support to ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations and permits. Job Duties & Responsibilities Leads environmental programs that provide specialized expertise to ensure cost effective environmental solutions Maximizes operational flexibility and environmental benefits for costs incurred Contributes to improved system reliability and customer satisfaction Translates regulations and permits into actionable tasks Provides guidance on alternatives to minimize environmental impacts Identifies, tracks, and analyzes environmental performance metrics Reviews, monitors, and comments on emerging environmental legislation and regulations Assists with development of strategy and communicate environmental requirements to management Performs other job-related duties as assigned Required Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree Experience: 7+ years Preferred Qualifications None Employee Group: Exempt Employee Type: Full Time Job Category: Environmental/Chemistry/Rad Protection Organization: NextEra Project Mgmt Location: Juno Beach, Florida Other Work Locations: Florida Relocation Provided: Yes, if applicable NextEra Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Lead Project Estimator - E&C
descriptionText: Requisition ID: 43691 NextEra Energy Resources is one of the largest wholesale generators of electric power and renewable energy from the wind and sun in North America. Position Specific Description NextEra Energy, the industry leader in clean energy, is seeking an innovative and dynamic Lead Project Estimator to join the Estimating Group within the Engineering & Construction Division, located in our Corporate Office, Juno Beach, FL. This senior level position will be filled by an individual with experience in renewable utility estimating or construction and a passion for helping NextEra Energy deliver clean, reliable power to its customers. The Lead Project Estimator will be a key member of the inventive and vibrant preconstruction estimating team and will support design of projects for NextEra Energy. The ideal candidate has experience in the renewable industry; a highly developed understanding of construction means and methods; a deep understanding of wind and solar construction requirements; robust project management skills and strong leadership qualities. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams involved in project development, planning and execution to develop project estimates and improve estimating tools. Preferred qualifications will include: • Bachelor’s Degree (or Higher) in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or Construction Science; • Experience in estimating projects in the Utility (Transmission), Power Generation, and Renewable Markets; • Experience in estimating projects in the Renewable Sector (Wind, Solar, Battery Storage) is a strong preference. This position is a Lead role within the estimating team, but not a management position. Day to day responsibilities include leading the preparation of estimates, the development of pricing models, and evaluating new technological innovations in the industry. The selected candidate will have the ability to grow their skillset, as our team also works on other technologies including energy storage, oil and gas pipelines, transmission lines, substations, and simple & combined cycle fossil power generation. Job Overview This position develops, quantifies, costs, and provides a complete capital expenditure (CapEx) model for evaluating projects. Employees in this role provide technical guidance, estimating knowledge, market pricing, and staffing considerations during the estimating process.Job Duties & Responsibilities • Prepares capital cost estimates • Reviews designs and specifications for cost effectiveness and suggests alternatives, when appropriate • Coordinates with other departments, ensuring understanding of project objectives and efficient utilization of resources • Reviews layouts, designs and specifications for cost effectiveness and suggests alternatives, when appropriate • Remains current with technology and industry evolution, assuring that capital estimates anticipate the correct market conditions • Establishes, builds and implements metrics for cost and construction estimate checks • Performs other job-related duties as assignedRequired Qualifications • Bachelor's or Equivalent Experience• Experience:7+ yearsPreferred Qualifications • None Employee Group: Exempt Employee Type: Full Time Job Category: Finance, Accounting & Business Analytics Organization: NextEra Energy Resources, LLC Location: Juno Beach, Florida Other Work Locations: Florida Relocation Provided: Yes, if applicable NextEra Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. locationRaw: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States of America, NC

descriptionText: We believe in entrepreneurship at Pine Gate and are looking for an experienced Transmission expert to join our growing Development team. You will be responsible for securing interconnection agreements for Pine Gate’s portfolio across the United States as well as developing transmission strategies to minimize curtailment/ congestion risk. The individual will not only be expected to have strong technical skills but should also demonstrate strategic approach, exceptional customer relationship and communication skills. If you find renewable development exciting, have experience with relevant software (PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld, PROMOD, GE MAPS etc.) and gets excited about solving complex transmission related challenges, we want to speak with you. It helps if you enjoy a fast-paced environment and like to have fun. Read on to learn more about how you will become a subject matter expert within our development team and help build the bright future. SUCCESS FACTORS (FIRST 12 MONTHS) Successfully navigate Interconnection Process: You have become a trusted guide to our development teams when it comes to getting the interconnection agreement executed with various utilities, ISOs and RTOs. You work with our project developers and engineering team on how to execute interconnection agreements while managing the cost. Development Support: You demonstrate the technical skills to guide the development teams by performing injection analysis, examine transmission congestion and provide critical inputs while prioritizing potential queue positions, due diligence for M&A prospects. Power Marketing Support: In this area, you bring the creative mind while supporting unique value proposition with the power marketing team. This involves ways to reduce the basis/congestion between the project and the trading hubs, explore wheeling strategies between the markets and running what-if analysis to understand the risk associated with the deliverability of the project. Cross-Functional support: At Pine Gate, we believe in teamwork. You work effectively with various teams (engineering, power marketing, and finance) as well as outside consultants to take the project from infancy stage to development and finally through execution phase. Effective Communication: Being an effective communicator is key to our success. As a technical and market expert, you learn on how to communicate your ideas to our team as well pursued our customers and investors especially while adopting new concepts while adopting new technologies. Quality control and efficiency: You have come up at least one process improvement idea on how to make the internal processes more efficient while maintaining or exceeding the quality of our work. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & ATTRIBUTES: BS in Electrical Engineering or related field, MBA or a Graduate degree in any discipline is a plus Proficiency in specific software (PowerWorld , GE PSLF,TARA and PSS/E, PROMOD, GE Maps, Aurora etc). Technical background includes experience in transmission planning or generator interconnection process, and previous employment with a utility, or an ISO/RTO or a renewable energy company. Familiarity with transmission systems and long-term transmission plans in various markets. Understanding of Open Access Transmission Tariffs, Interconnection Procedures and Study Methodologies for utilities as well as ISO/RTO regions Comfort working in a high volume; fast-paced, results-oriented environment Keen attention to detail and the accuracy of data Superb communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to provide updates at all levels as well as the ability to tailor communications to suit a variety of audience High customer service standards At Pine Gate Renewables, we are committed to developing solar farms throughout the country and quickly complimenting with the storage technology.
